items.title: Chennai: 285 with criminal records detained in crime prevention drive
items.summary: Nearly 285 people with criminal records, including history-sheeters, were arrested in a special drive conducted across Chennai, with police claiming that the operation was aimed at preventing crime and curbing the activities of habitual offenders. They were detained during an intensive search operation carried out from Thursday, September 10 night to Friday, September 11 evening, following directions from Greater Chennai Police Commissioner A Amalraj. The operation was conducted under the supervision of Deputy Commissioners and led by Assistant Commissioners, Inspectors and other police personnel. Of the 285 people detained, 108 were from the North Zone, 38 from the West Zone, 94 from the South Zone and 45 from the East Zone. “During the operation, the teams detained 285 individuals with criminal backgrounds, whose history sheets are maintained at various police stations in the city. They are being questioned to ascertain their current activities and possible involvement in recent offences,” a senior police officer said.
